text:
Nora (People Ops): FYI guest arriving 11:00am early. Courier left an oversized crate + small potted plant. Guest name: Dr. Patel (Univ. Northbridge). Lobby is pretty full — can we stash the crate and have a badge ready?

Ethan (Front Desk): Logged crate as PKG-991 and plant as PLT-55. Temporarily on the bench by the elevator. No calendar entry under 'Patel'  whos the host?

Ava: That's my meeting  calendar shows 'Univ. Northbridge sync at 11'. Ill be there at 10:50. Can we reserve the sofa near the demo wall for them?

Nora (People Ops): Reserve sofa for Dr. Patel. Also please check if they need a visitor wifi code and dietary notes.

Ethan (Front Desk): Badge printer ready. Need ID scan when they arrive. I'll keep crate off the main walkway. Also we only have one hotdesk free by kitchen  Ava, do you want me to label it "Guest - Univ. Northbridge"?

Ava: Yes please label it. Guest might have one assistant. I'll move my laptop to bench 4.

Luis (Facilities): If crate looks heavy I can bring a cart and move it to Storage C. Also will move plant to the greenroom so it doesn't drip.

MailBot: PKG-991 scanned at 10:12. Photo: pkg_1839001201.jpg. Delivery note: "left at front desk".

Sam: Heads up  catering dropped a small box of snacks for the meeting but it isn't labeled "vegan". Ava, does Dr. Patel need anything specific?

Ava: Dr. Patel is vegetarian. Please set aside the non-labeled snacks and we'll swap for fruit platter. Thanks Sam.

Ethan (Front Desk): Guest checked in at 11:04. ID scanned, badge printed as "Dr. N. Patel (Univ. Northbridge)" and wifi code handed over. Crate moved to Storage C by Luis. Plant in greenroom. Sofa and hotdesk labeled. All good. :white_check_mark:

Nora (People Ops): Great job team  appreciate the quick pivots.

Ava: Thanks everyone!
